reason: Feasibility/schedule lens. The rule edit costs nothing to write (no code, no GPU, no hidden-run time; byte-identical-when-off and fail-soft do not apply), but it adds almost nothing to the plan and part of its mechanism is wrong. (1) Stack+variant ordering is already pre-registered: CONTEXT l.1598-1599 has K3b = K3 (or K2) + t* and K4 = current F1 stack + tempfuse, so each variant's twin is scored by construction. (3) Insertion ON in every K build is already branch A (#35 0.954 >= #34 0.953). The one extra slot this part needs belongs to the separate noins-twin-f2 idea (exp58n: not built, not pre-approved for the night). (2) The only new element is 'do not consolidate D and T at S12'. Its rationale, that consolidation removes the leave-one-out twin, does not hold for this schedule. At K4 build time (~18:00 26 Sep) K3b is still unscored, so D and T sit in separate files S+D and S+T, and S (K2/K3) is scored too. A consolidated S+D+T then has both leave-one-out twins plus the bare stack available: consolidation only adds an option, and it costs slot S12 (scored ~19:00 28 Sep, before the 20:00 29 Sep tick). I reran the lens's own priors (scratchpad pair_dt_mc.py). Consolidating and ticking the bare stack, {S+D+T, S}, gives P(>X) 0.967/0.952/0.967/0.952 across four D/T scenarios, against 0.960/0.925/0.963/0.929 for the separate pair {S+D, S+T}. finals_mc2.py, the cited evidence, never modelled D-vs-T consolidation. 'Let the calculator decide' does not rescue the idea. The calculator is an uncommitted scratchpad script with guessed priors, so it only works if it is frozen in git before the K3b/K4 scores and R8 (27 Sep 12:00); otherwise it becomes a post-hoc choice on 3-decimal public scores. Freezing it is the separate finals-pair-calculator idea. The runtime claim ('tempfuse +0.2-0.5 h inside the ~4 h headroom') measures against the wrong limit. The binding one is the 8.0 h insertion gate (BIOHUB_DIVINS_DEADLINE_S=28800; step0.md: worst-case margin ~0.2 h), not 12 h. Tempfuse runs before insertion, so it can trip the gate on the last clips of K4 or S+D+T. That is fail-soft, but the pair stops being a clean leave-one-out. Tempfuse code does not exist yet (nothing in tools/). T would need new code and a dummy on 26 Sep, S6 at ~18:00, and a score around 27 Sep 02-04 UTC with no retry before R8. So the world 'both D and T scored with delta >= 0' is small.
fix: Drop parts (1) and (3), which are already the plan. Replace (2) with a pre-registered rule committed to CONTEXT before any K3b/K4 score: if accepted riders end up in separate files, build and submit the S12 consolidated file as planned. Choose the ticked pair only with a calculator committed to tools/ with frozen priors by 27 Sep 12:00, and include the bare stack S (K2/K3) as a candidate partner. Add a runtime gate for any rider that runs before insertion (tempfuse): its dummy-projected hidden runtime must keep the last clip's insertion start <= 7.6 h, or DIVINS_DEADLINE_S must be raised in the same build (K2 has 9.5 h repair and 12 h hard margins).
realistic_gain: ~0 over v3 plus the separate calculator/noins-twin ideas. A fixed 'never consolidate' rule would be slightly negative under the lens's own MC: about -0.007..-0.027 P(>X) against consolidating and ticking the bare stack. Only when the calculator is frozen does the idea reduce to finals-pair-calculator.
